name: Cranfield University

facts.text: Cranfield's main campus is at College Road, Cranfield, Bedfordshire, MK43 0AL, with a second campus at Shrivenham, Swindon, SN6 8LA.
Cranfield is a specialist postgraduate university with large-scale facilities and industry partnerships, creating leaders in technology and management.
Cranfield is the largest UK provider of master's-level graduates in engineering and offers a flagship MBA and executive education programmes.

Cranfield's distinctive expertise is in how technology and management work together, and its research and consultancy for industry, government and business gives students a real-world learning environment.
